notes.title: Version 2.29.0 - FD LONG BEACH '24, BETTER BRAKE BALANCE, TWITCH CRATE COMEBACK!
notes.notes:
It's time to gear up for Formula Drift Season 2024! Update 2.29.0 will transport you straight to Long Beach as we kick off the series with a season-long leaderboard event – Get ready for unique round challenges with fantastic prizes in-game AND in the real world for the top scorers! Plus, experience improved control over brake balance on pro/stock vehicles for an even more exhilarating driving experience!

[b]FORMULA DRIFT ROUND 1 – LONG BEACH![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/4a647d3cce3f15d2e2ed72b4c240f531424fe40e.png[/img]

WE’RE BACK AT IT. Under the shade of California Palm trees, we shred tyres and feel the smoky breeze. 🌴 Long Beach-exclusive challenges, sponsortree, titles & rewards are up for grabs for a limited time only! Don’t you miss competing during the Formula DRIFT season? 

* FD Long Beach Challenges & sponsortrees will be active from UTC 9PM, 12 April - 9PM, 19 April

[b]FORMULA DRIFT 2024 CHAMPIONSHIP![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/076140d4ab273ef4382ae01ba7714238f019df0b.png[/img]

IT CONTINUES. Since launching our official in-game Formula DRIFT Championship in 2022, we've consistently been impressed by the remarkable runs, closely contested standings, stunning liveries, and positive feedback for the event. Running our own series alongside the real FD season has been a thrill for both the players and us developers, and we're excited to witness the best drifters of the FD Championship in 2024!

How the event works:

[list]
[*] Round 1 – Entry Cost: 50x Bullion
[*] (Entry cost will be reduced at the start of each round)
[*] In-Game and IRL Prizes for the Top 8 Leaderboard Players at the end of Irwindale!
[*] Round standings will be automatically calculated for each round. As each round’s points accumulate, results will be displayed on a separate Overall Leaderboard system players can access and view in-game.
[/list]

Stay tuned for the prizes we have for you! 

[b]THE RETURN OF TWITCH REWARDS![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/3b300e272854fa7ff5061cd4b8c0a06316a0f965.png[/img]

WE LOVE FREE STUFF TOO. Our Torque Drift Twitch Crate is back to give you MONTHLY goodies! 😋 

How do you get your hands on these rewards? 

1. Subscribe to our #Twitch HERE: twitch.tv/torquemotorsport
2. Login into Torque Drift via the main menu with the same Twitch account you subscribed with
3. Collect your crate⁠ & redeem your monthly goodies!


[b]IMPROVED BRAKE BALANCE![/b]

Discover the excitement of fine-tuning brake balance on both pro and stock vehicles. Enjoy a more thrilling driving experience with enhanced control, making every moment behind the wheel even more exciting and immersive!


[b]BUG FIXES & PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Twitch channel link to take you to the correct page
[*] Fixed AVS model T5 (np) alloys rear width
[*] Fixed the Long Beach lag, ensuring smoother gameplay for all players just in time for FD Championship Round 1
[/list]

As always, thank you to our awesome community for helping us improve the game every update! Gearin' up for a big season and it’s only just the beginning y’all!

– Torque Drift Team

notes.notes:
YO YO DRIFTERS! We’re whippin' out the tools and cable ties for Update 2.19.0 as we tackle some more game optimisation and performance issues that we have -very much heard- from you. Read on to find out what the team has been working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/21be20c95656f39e06a9cf75b851ff3c173cc39e.png[/img]
Ebisu is getting the love it deserves this year, and we’re not stopping with another layout to the iconic map! Hillside boasts amazing elevation changes, and is the ideal track to tandem on due to the well timed deceleration zones (+ left foot braking opportunities)!

As there aren’t any outstanding new features or major bug fixes in this update (hear us out here!) – We’re getting into the nitty-gritties of addressing performance issues and crash rates that have been occurring.

There are a number of contributing factors to players' game stability being interfered with, one of which being hardware longevity. In 2.18.0, we introduced a graphics quality setting cap for lower end devices with the intention of allowing said players to still enjoy the game, but not at the expense of relaunching the game over and over again, which as a result… dramatically taints the gameplay experience.

The TD team have spent this update digging deeper into untouched corners of the game to implement more changes where possible to ultimately retune old systems, optimise the game better to cover a wider pool of devices, as well as making quality of life improvements to UI, game flow, and more!


[b]BUG FIXES & PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Delete Button repositioned in selection screen, users will now need to type CONFIRM to delete account
[*] Long titles are now scrollable
[*] Lighting updates on maps: WWT, Hakone, Gingerman
[*] Addressed memory leak issues
[*] & More!
[/list]

While we may not be able to list out all the technicalities here, this is also groundwork for more future improvements and features we have planned for 2023. As always, any and all feedback is appreciated!
 

– Torque Drift Team

notes.title: Version 2.0.0 - PC Release! Torque Drift goes FREE, now with Adam LZ!

Sup Drifters!

We've been hard at work to bring Torque Drift to PC for a little over a year, and it is with great pleasure that we're finally able to announce it leaving STEAM Early Access! We've worked hard to add open lobbies, wheel support, new drivers, cars, tracks, tournaments and so much more to the game, and we can't wait to share it with you!

First and foremost, we're going free-to-play! A big thank you to all the Early Access adopters who made this possible for us, as we're now able to be free-to-play across iOS, Android and now PC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/1b0a234b5345110b23e8b02c8ec14708ac334cee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/afef3f2c8f56e10eb203a3dcd987fc70f3f62199.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/fd2e6bfc9ed611d403540b2cc29d50b64d35b6f7.png[/img]

We're rewarding more skilful driving and increasingly weighting the points on proximity to clipping points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/a2c79022af14f62d79610aac0d1421bfd9f5ae3f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/cf0285ab17fab0ebbca09cd4a9d51b20585019c8.png[/img]

If you're playing on Pikes Peak or Plock, you'll now be able to see your headlights themselves, instead of just their light on the track. We've also been able to go through each of our interiors, increasing the resolution for many of the cars to fit with the PC standard we've set on some of our popular cars.

[h3][b]New Items in the store![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/10d29a667e5238595f367b097e7c82a387e47921.jpg[/img]

We're letting Update 1.9.0 out into the wild! Enjoy a refresh for an old favourite, a bunch of new body kits, some new music + a MUSTANG FULL of fixes for references, exceptions, crashes and performance!

[h3][b]Hakone Remastered[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/9c2eabdab921e6796ea27dc87f3c764c11709c5f.png[/img]
We've taken Hakone to the garage and given it a full facelift. You'll find new Hidden Paths, your old favourite layouts and new records to be made on Tunnel Edge. We've added details like pagodas, mountains and more in this beautiful rendition of the mountain track we know and love! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/eb0661277a6158bd903c2b50edcce915bfa9a013.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Pro Livery: George K 2020[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/d940fc61be11d575b2ce9e62cdd95a91d41e8059.png[/img]
We've added George K's SMOKING black 2020 competition livery to the livery options in Torque Drift. If you haven't got George K yet, we can bet you'll want him with this sweet new livery upgrade! Tag him on social media and you're sure to get some fire emojis and a whole lot of love for reppin' our man George!

[h3][b]Bdice "Aesthetic" Album Launch[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/650bae96b87d68bdb3bd947ad7798a52981dd1e3.png[/img]
With Bdice dropping his third album, we're stoked to be able to do our own launch party in Torque Drift! It'll now be in the Garage and the Paintshop, with his beats and tunes to get you into the vibe of building your dream drift missile. To celebrate his new album "Aesthetic", we've got a Sponsor Tree Challenge with a bunch of challenges and some superchargers to win sweet decals, so get drifting and show him some love! We'll be hosting some photoshoot contests and more over the next few weeks, so keep an eye on our socials!

[h3][b]New Part: 3 Spoke Advan Wheel[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/4fe51a775f7bab2162549d59824ba3d1b7fcffa0.png[/img]
Discontinued in real life, we couldn't wait to get our hands on this GORGEOUS 3 spoke alloy for Torque Drift! It's unique, it's different, so slap it on some cars or merely add it to your collection!

[h3][b]New Bodykit: RX3[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/593d55b2f7c90f97b17b3eaeb762885e28560248.png[/img]
Alright already! We heard you! We've had this body kit in the works since the induction of the RX3 into the game, and we're proud to announce it's finally here! Dust off that old classic in your garage, and give it new life with this THICC kit!

[h3][b]New Bodykit: RX8[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/8b89423721192c07429bd30cddeacb5b3adb19e3.png[/img]
Another fan favourite, you've been asking, and we've been able to add in the RX8 body kit this update as well! No longer will your RX8 be a stock-boi. Get wide and get beefy with this new body kit.

[h3][b]New Bodykit: E92[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/2e0bee2b5abc8809c444069b9979b79b1da65907.png[/img]
We've added some sweet Clinched parts recently, and this E92 bodykit is no exception! It's got flash and it's got bold strong lines to set you out from the crowd! Big ups to Clinched for letting us get this wide bodykit in the game, you can check out more of their stock here;
[url=https://www.clinchedflares.com/]https://www.clinchedflares.com/[/url]

[h3][b]New Features: Photoshoots and Lookback[/b][/h3]
We've made sure the lookback feature is an option instead of on by default, so if you're tapping away and messing up your flow, go into the menu and flick off the look back function in the controls settings. When you're in open lobbies, your car will now auto handbrake in drone made, to keep your wheels on the track to help you take that new favourite photo of yours!

notes.title: Version 1.8.9 - Płock And Halloween!
notes.notes:
Sup Drifters!

Update 1.8.9 is here! We've got a spooky Halloween update with a new stadium, a ton of decals, some new Tournament and chat functions and more! Whether you're an artist with a car or with a paintbrush, there's something for you in this update!

[h3][b]Feature: New Stadium Track, Płock![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/9f527a9979011a04eddf370dd3099190de980f6d.png[/img]
We've got Płock Stadium to drift around in Torque Drift! With some tight turns and a bright stadium, we hope you enjoy this new night track. With a football pitch, stands and a Drift Lodge to pose in front of for photos, we think you'll love this new track! 

[h3][b]Feature: Halloween![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/e222ca03d4d69aa312e4bac2ec53722f178fe5b9.png[/img]
It's our Halloween update! Pick up some pumpkin crates and design your ultimate nightmare livery with over a hundred new decals, 3 new alloys and a horrific sounding horn to celebrate Halloween! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/10fcb5abca8e012ea2abf4db5afe9c166a5aef09.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.8.8 - Tutorials and Drones!
notes.notes:
Sup Drifters!

Update 1.8.8 is now live! We’ve rebuilt our tutorial for new players, added a horn button, a flying drone, and more!

[h3][b]Feature: New FTUE for driving, first event, and garage.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.8.6 - Open Lobbies
notes.notes:
Update 1.8.6 is here. The biggest update since the initial Early Access, we’ve brought OPEN LOBBIES (ONLINE MULTIPLAYER) to the game, as well as new layouts, a new track, high-resolution interiors and more!

[h3][b]OPEN LOBBIES[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/9cacb594ce8ce6fada8c341721a3be36d522e739.png[/img]
The most requested feature since Torque Drift’s initial release, we’re proud to announce that Open Lobbies are now in the game! You’ll be able to create a custom game mode to hang out with friends, drift real-time tandems and run crew photoshoots with our free-roam camera! Whether you’re wanting to hang out with friends, chat, drift or battle, there’s something for everyone in this new game mode. You’ll be able to play on any track, invite friends with private codes or join a public lobby.

It’s cross-platform, you can switch collisions on/off, and we can’t wait to see what you get up to in this new game mode! 

[b][h3]NEW TRACK: PIKES PEAK[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/80d7ffe6faa28e30d7b85f0131e871b96decf3d5.png[/img]
We’ve added the sprawling Pikes Peak to Torque Drift! One of our largest tracks to date, whether you’re after some road action, a drag strip, a NASCAR style raceway or the tight turns of a go-kart track, there’s something for you at Pikes Peak. There are 4 different layouts to try on Pikes Peak, each with something different on offer. On PC, you'll drift Pikes Peak at night, with headlights on your cars, and a party atmosphere at the track. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/8fbee78cbdd5b64061624a93c54855773241ad84.png[/img]

[b][h3]TUNE SAVING[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/a9915aa1c4075ba456597d0268af43c04db64608.png[/img]
Want to try new tunes, but go back to your old faithful ones from time to time? Or maybe you’d like to tune cars to specific tracks or layouts to get the peak performance out of your ride? 

With our new tune saving feature, you’ll be able to change your loadout in one click, meaning you can try out new suspension, camber, even neon, spoiler and body kits before deciding on what you’ll take to the track!

[h3][b]HD INTERIORS[/b][/h3]
As part of our PC Overhaul, we’re rebuilding our interiors, which means gorgeous new detail for some fan favourites. In this update, we’re including revamps for the S14, the RX-7 and the E46 for PC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/6a7eb7492132736d2477d98de7254e1da92a72e4.png[/img]
[i]S14 interior pictured.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/88a0c524a70b931a72886b62cddfb57c56eb6ee6.png[/img]
Heading to your profile will now show you where on the Torque Drift rankings you’re sitting. You’ll see icons whether you’re a Grassroots drifter or a Drift King, so get climbing!

notes.title: Version 1.8.5 - E-Town!
notes.notes:
Sup Drifters!

Update 1.8.5 is here. We’ve got a new track, layouts, a new manufacturer onboard and some exciting clutches to add to Torque Drift!

[h3][b]New Clutches:[/b][/h3]

We’ve been able to add Exedy Clutches to the game, with 6 new parts being added.
We’ve included the following Exedy clutch models;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/23e379aaf153b11b46f22b791dc4e2e4fcc66747.png[/img]

[i]EXEDY Stage 1 [/i]
Resistant to slippage and burst, with increased clamp loads for light horsepower track and street use.

[i]EXEDY Stage 2[/i]
Handles high power modified engines, with cerametallic friction that handles much more abuse than stock type disc assemblies.

[i]EXEDY Single Disc Hyper [/i]
With a series of turbine-like pressure plates to increase airflow, the EXEDY Hyper Single Series Clutch is engineered to optimize the performance of moderately modified cars with a purple anodized, forged aluminium cover.

[i]EXEDY Twin Disc Hyper[/i]
The clutch a lot of drifters are using, this clutch kit and ultralight flywheel offer a Multi-Plate design ideal for high powered street, rally and road racing, with almost 1000ft/lbs of torque at the flywheel.

[i]Exedy Carbon Hyper[/i]
The flagship model of the EXEDY Clutches originated in Formula One in 1995. Now the same technology is in street cars with lightweight, durable, resilient to high heat factors all contributing to faster track times.

[i]Exedy Triple Disc Hyper[/i]
For the highest power street, drag, road and rally racing, the EXEDY Triple Disc Hyper comes with a lightweight, Chromoly steel flywheel and the famous purple anodized forged aluminum clutch cover. They’ve got huge heat resistance and a patented clutch “cushion” design.

[h3][b]New Track :[/b][/h3]
[i]Englishtown (E-town)[/i]
New Jersey race fans delight! We’re adding E-town Raceway park to Torque Drift. This seasoned race track has been given a new life with its inclusion into the Formula Drift Championship in 2021! You’ll have a chance to drive it before the pros do! The big question, would you drift the Go-Karts track, the carpark, or the drag strip?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/5a91ee5c53dd790139b987b90cd5ecb42f391b4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/156b47e438b330ba599a48e70b64626f0aa72f48.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/0237dd799087c0b83fb3f78b9725b9cf0d08b14c.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Part:[/b][/h3]

[i]Pro Spec Import Spoilers[/i]
With PRO SPEC IMPORTS entering Torque Drift, you’ll be able to take their wing and slap it on your Supra. We’re also adding their Logo to the Sponsor Tree and their decal to the PaintShop!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/5d6dcd5c847c10beb96f0035856fa785e7fb57f4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Wheel Support (Beta) Improvements.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/1ef07e5ffcf224617fd7d86c47926256f5f92a32.jpg[/img]
We’ve been continuing to develop and improve our wheel support for Logitech wheels to more accurately replicate what real drifting feels like. We have made adjustments to how the force feedback feels and fixed multiple bugs. We are confident that we are moving in the right direction, although we are continuing to work with real pro drifters to get the right feel! 

After we are happy with how the Logitech wheels feel, we will move onto wider support for other brands! Currently, the best setup is to have your driving style set to Aggressive or Smooth. (Unassisted will not feel accurate and isn’t named correctly currently)

notes.title: Version 1.8.3 - Mazda Month!
notes.notes:
Sup Drifters!

Welcome to Torque Drift Mazda Month! Where we'll be launching new Mazda car every Friday for the next 3 weeks! 
To kick things off we've got the stock RX7 FC and Mad Mikes RX8!
Followed by the RX8 Stock on the 03rd of July, Mad Mikes Pro RX7.3 on the 10th of July, and the RX3 Savanna on the 17th of July.

Each car will roll out with a special event with limited time rewards! Whether you’re into classics, customs or modern drift cars, there’s something for you in this update, and we can’t wait to see the new cars hitting the track! 

It's not all about new cars though! We also have some exciting new changes to a the Slab track, new sticker packs, and Dan Burketts 2020 livery!

[h3][b]Stock Cars:[/b][/h3]

[i]RX7 FC (S5) 1992 - Available now![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/847846231ec9ec47b9e8687895d99561d6534e52.png[/img]

A fan favourite with a really cool profile, the RX7 FC. A 2 door Coupe powered by a 1.3L 13B-DEI Wankel Rotary. Available now in the garage!

[i]RX-8 - Available 3rd of July![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/524e8aa6f8ee7641e3079de4a587194159686921.png[/img]

One for the modern drifters, the RX-8 is the 2002 iteration of the legendary Coupe/Sportscar from Mazda, and rounds out our additions to the new stock cars in this update. Originally powered by a 1.3L Wankel Rotary, it’s now the popular drift chassis of FD Drivers like Kyle Mohan as well as Legendary Red Bull Driver, Mad Mike Whiddett. Available in the garage after the 03rd of July!

[i]RX-3 S124 Series 3 Savanna 1977 - Available 17th of July![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/99cfa293b1a8d7da140765c96d8dfb9989009f63.png[/img]

Small and sporty, this RX-3 was powered by a 12-A rotary, and was one of the most popular rotaries to hit the streets before the RX-7 took up the mantle. Available in the garage after the 17th of July!


[h3][b]Professional Driver Cars[/b][/h3]

On the Pro Car Front, we’ve added 2 cars from Mad Mike Whiddett’s Garage, the Madbul, and the Badbul. These Pro Cars have got new engine’s roaring under the bonnet, and they’re some of the most fun cars in the game to date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/8edc06a9390b47e0a7351be690e0443a57a03482.png[/img]

[i]Badbul - Available now![/i]

Mad Mike’s second pro-specification competition car build is also the only one to still retain its original race motor configuration – a triple-rotor 20B with a single turbocharger. Of all the cars that Whiddett has campaigned, he’s had the most success with BADBUL, standing on the podium at every round of the D1NZ National Championship in 2009 and also taking out the NZ Drift Series title the same year.


[i]Madbul - Available 10th of July![/i]

Starting its life as a 1992 Mazda RX7 FD, MADBUL is “Mad” Mike Whiddett’s first truly international drift car with a history stretching back over a decade. It’s got a Rocket Bunny custom body kit to blend the 1990s RX7 shape with the 1970s RX3 front. As such, it’s known as the RX7.3.


[h3][b]Sponsor Tree:[/b][/h3]

Improvements and the addition of Mad Mike!

With Mad Mike’s garage getting some serious muscle this update, we’ve put him in the Sponsor Tree. Mad Mike’s Sponsor Tree includes: Lead and chase challenges, driving and following Mad Mikes whole garage, Humbul, Radbul, Madbul and Badbul.
Three tiers of challenges, three tiers of rewards, highest being the RX3. If you can drift well enough you can be the first in game to drive the Savannah before its official release!

notes.title: Version 1.8.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
Sup Drifters!

Update 1.8.0 is now available and brings with it a tonne of new content and features, including new parts, cars, and cross platform account linking from Mobile to PC!



[h3][b]Account Linking:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/41b51937cbb1875b419f931bdcf8ef9ce584a0f9.jpg[/img]

You can now link a previously made Mobile Torque Drift account to your Torque Drift Steam account! This will move across all save files so that they are accessible to play on both devices!

To link your mobile with your PC accounts, log out on one device, then click ‘Link Account’ Follow the prompts on the other device that you would like to link!
[b]Note:[/b] You can only link devices once! So make sure you do this process on the correct devices!
You can only link 1 Mobile device to 1 PC device. Save file merging is not currently supported.



[h3][b]New Parts:[/b][/h3]

[i]Ford GT[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/a3ac17199b75d380726b5fbe7ea53af54666757d.jpg[/img]

Luxury cars are not often seen on the drift track burning tires, with notable exception of Formula Drift Pro 1 Driver Federico Sceriffo in his 6.0-litre V12-engined Ferrari 599. Though if given the chance, I'm sure we would all be keen to get behind the wheel and get one sideways. 

We’re excited to bring this incredible RWD Supercar into the game to see what you guys do with it! 


[i]Custom Wings from Big Country labs![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/3f3a8a9012b7a2887a965df642c54a851b780e30.png[/img]

Adding custom wings have been on our agenda for some time now, and we’re pleased to announce the day is finally here! You can now enter the ‘Spoilers’ section of the part store from within the garage and choose from a selection of top or rear mounted BCL wings to customize your car with! 

With adjustable wing angle (For more Downforce!) and strut distance on most wings, this new addition adds a new level of customisation to your whole garage.

[b]Note: [/b]Wings are not only a visual upgrade, but they now hold the ‘Rear Down force’ stat which was previously on the bodykit. ‘Front Down force’ still remains as a tunable stat on the bodykit.


[i]Wilwood Brakes[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/f1706afb61978342152fbaaab4ad48f580fc4f8a.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]New BodyKit:[/b][/h3]

[i]370z Neo Samurai Calavera [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/5db3738a19f0ca4d4ea2b3619e4cf2e1744ad5a3.png[/img]

One of Torque Drift’s artists Stefan TD: StefBear47 has created a fresh take on the 370z body kit and livery, drawing inspiration from the Mexican ‘Calavera’ Day of the dead Holiday.

Keeping in theme with both this update, and the Neo Samurai style, the kit is fitted with a massive wing.



[h3][b]New HD Interiors:[/b][/h3]

[i]Vaughn Gittin Jr.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/f39b3de6b3e9aa8cc6a8000dea5a0f0528185c74.jpg[/img]

[i]Chelsea Denofa[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/d88bf2e5d91cab239b1e2f0dc24a07a566b901a0.jpg[/img]

[i]Darren Kelly[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/b4d728a0103797ff38412e38b730dc7370882cc1.jpg[/img]

[i]Jonathan Nerren[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/e916c8d536910d3590d4f21543cf49df335e0c5c.jpg[/img]

This update brings with it a handful of new HD interiors which will unlock the interior drive camera on the cars above!



[h3][b]Wheel Support (Beta):[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/1ef07e5ffcf224617fd7d86c47926256f5f92a32.jpg[/img]

We have opened up wheel support into a beta state with initial support for both the Logitech G920 and G29 Wheels. 
[b]Note:[/b] We are after lots of feedback on how these are feeling. The current state of the wheel support does not reflect what the final support will feel like. Support for all other major wheel manufacturers such as Fanatec and Thrustmasters is in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/5c00cf805e2dc1e2d1f7f9fdfb8caec07175afa5.jpg[/img]

You can access the wheel mapping option from the control settings once you have connected your Logitech G920 and G29 wheel. There will also be an option in the bottom left to check input.



[h3][b]4-Player Local Split screen:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36735840/dbc96cdbc1d7d6c3441ba750b3702a473f748586.png[/img]

You can now drift with your friends in the local freeroam 4 player split screen!
We’ve got big plans for 4-player split screen, with unique party game modes on the way. But for the time being, enjoy 4 player drift trains! 
Accessible from the Practice tab in events, on any ‘FreeRoam’ layout. 

For those of you that are eager to play online with more than 4 people on the track, don’t worry. Open lobbies are already in development and will be coming in the following months.

[i]Rad Dan Industries, LinkECU[/i]
